# .github — SupplySight AI

## Purpose

GitHub-specific automation and contribution templates: CI/CD workflows, issue forms, and pull request template.

## Contents

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `workflows/` | GitHub Actions YAML pipelines |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` | Bug / feature issue templates |
| `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` | Standard PR checklist |

## Future Implementation

- CI for lint/test on PR
- CD deploy workflows for staging/production
- CODEOWNERS when team roster is finalized
